title: Grok Build
description: Usage, cost, tokens, turns and tool activity reported by Grok Build agents, by VM and nexus persona.

list.name: host
list.label: VM
list.description: host.name of the agent VM (from the X-Nexus-Host header)

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.description: Applies to every panel whose data has a model; Tool Decisions and Startup have none

panels.title: Sessions

targets.expr: count(count by (session_id) (last_over_time(grok_code_token_usage_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

panels.description: Distinct Grok Build sessions that used tokens in the period.

panels.title: Turns

targets.expr: sum (increase(grok_code_turn_count_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Turns that ended in the period, any outcome. A turn is one prompt and all the work it triggers.

panels.title: Personas

targets.expr: count(count by (persona) (last_over_time(grok_code_token_usage_total{persona!="", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

panels.description: Distinct nexus personas with token usage. Data sent without the X-Nexus-Persona header has no persona and isn't counted.

panels.title: Users

targets.expr: count(count by (user_email) (last_over_time(grok_code_token_usage_total{user_email!="", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

panels.description: Distinct Grok accounts (user_email) with token usage.

panels.title: Total Cost

targets.expr: sum (increase(grok_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Cost reported by Grok Build.

panels.title: Total Tokens

targets.expr: sum (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type=~"input|output", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Input + output tokens. Grok Build counts cache reads inside input and reasoning inside output, so they aren't added again.

panels.title: Tool Calls

targets.expr: sum (increase(grok_code_tool_usage_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Tool executions, any outcome.

panels.title: Failed Tool Calls

targets.expr: sum (increase(grok_code_tool_usage_total{outcome!="success", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Tool executions whose outcome isn't success.

panels.title: Tokens by Type

targets.expr: sum (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type="input", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) - (sum (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type="cache_read", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) or vector(0))
sum (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type="cache_read", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

sum (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type="output", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) - (sum (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type="reasoning", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) or vector(0))
sum (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type="reasoning", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: Token totals per type. Grok Build counts cache reads inside input and reasoning inside output, so uncached input + cache read + output (excl. reasoning) + reasoning = input + output.

panels.title: Turn Outcomes

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (increase(grok_code_turn_count_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: Turns per outcome as Grok Build reports it, e.g. completed.

panels.title: Tool Decisions

targets.expr: sum by (decision, permission_mode) (increase(grok_code_tool_decision_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: Tool permission decisions by decision and permission mode. always_approve = the agent runs every tool without asking; a decision other than allow is worth a look. Not filtered by Model: Grok Build doesn't label this metric with a model.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio

targets.expr: sum (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type="cache_read", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)) / sum (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type="input", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored))

panels.description: Share of input tokens served from the prompt cache: cache_read / input (Grok Build counts cache reads inside input). Higher is cheaper.

panels.title: Sessions without persona

targets.expr: count(count by (session_id) (last_over_time(grok_code_token_usage_total{persona="", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.description: Sessions whose data arrived without the X-Nexus-Persona header (Grok Build started outside nexus, or the header not set). They count in the totals but under no persona. Ignores the VM and Persona filters.

panels.title: Top Personas by Cost

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, label_replace(label_replace(sum by (host_name, persona) (increase(grok_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)), "host_name", "(none)", "host_name", ""), "persona", "(none)", "persona", "")))

panels.description: Top 10 VM · persona pairs by cost.

panels.title: Top Users by Cost

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, label_replace(sum by (user_email) (increase(grok_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)), "user_email", "(none)", "user_email", "")))

panels.description: Top 10 accounts by cost.

panels.title: Top Sessions by Cost

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, label_replace(label_replace(sum by (session_id, host_name, persona) (increase(grok_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)), "host_name", "(none)", "host_name", ""), "persona", "(none)", "persona", "")))

panels.description: Top 10 sessions by cost. Search the session id in Explore → Loki for its events.

panels.title: Cost share by Model

targets.expr: sum by (model) (increase(grok_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored))

panels.description: Share of cost per model.

panels.title: Tool Calls by Tool

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (increase(grok_code_tool_usage_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored))

panels.description: Share of tool executions per tool.

panels.title: Stop Reasons

targets.expr: sum by (stop_reason) (count_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | stop_reason!="" [$__range]))

panels.description: Why each model API call stopped, e.g. toolcalls = the model asked for tools, stop = it finished. API calls are the events that carry a stop_reason.

panels.title: Usage by VM and persona

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(count by (host_name, persona, user_email) (count by (host_name, persona, user_email, session_id) (last_over_time(grok_code_token_usage_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))), "host_name", "(none)", "host_name", ""), "persona", "(none)", "persona", ""), "user_email", "(none)", "user_email", "")

label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (host_name, persona, user_email) (increase(grok_code_turn_count_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)), "host_name", "(none)", "host_name", ""), "persona", "(none)", "persona", ""), "user_email", "(none)", "user_email", "")

label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (host_name, persona, user_email) (increase(grok_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)), "host_name", "(none)", "host_name", ""), "persona", "(none)", "persona", ""), "user_email", "(none)", "user_email", "")

label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (host_name, persona, user_email) (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type=~"input|output", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)), "host_name", "(none)", "host_name", ""), "persona", "(none)", "persona", ""), "user_email", "(none)", "user_email", "")

label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (host_name, persona, user_email) (increase(grok_code_tool_usage_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)), "host_name", "(none)", "host_name", ""), "persona", "(none)", "persona", ""), "user_email", "(none)", "user_email", "")

label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (host_name, persona, user_email) (increase(grok_code_tool_usage_total{outcome!="success", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)), "host_name", "(none)", "host_name", ""), "persona", "(none)", "persona", ""), "user_email", "(none)", "user_email", "")

label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (host_name, persona, user_email) (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type="cache_read", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)) / (sum by (host_name, persona, user_email) (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type="input", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)) > 0), "host_name", "(none)", "host_name", ""), "persona", "(none)", "persona", ""), "user_email", "(none)", "user_email", "")

label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (host_name, persona, user_email) (increase(grok_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)) / (sum by (host_name, persona, user_email) (increase(grok_code_turn_count_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)) > 0), "host_name", "(none)", "host_name", ""), "persona", "(none)", "persona", ""), "user_email", "(none)", "user_email", "")

label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((max by (host_name, persona, user_email) (timestamp({__name__=~"grok_code_(token_usage|turn_count|cost_usage_USD)_total", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"})) or max by (host_name, persona, user_email) (max_over_time(timestamp({__name__=~"grok_code_(token_usage|turn_count|cost_usage_USD)_total", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"})[$__range:5m]))) * 1000, "host_name", "(none)", "host_name", ""), "persona", "(none)", "persona", ""), "user_email", "(none)", "user_email", "")

panels.description: One row per VM, persona and account. Tokens = input + output. Cache hit = cache_read / input. Failed tool calls = tool executions whose outcome isn't success. Click a column header to sort.

panels.title: Grok Build versions

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(count by (host_name, persona, service_version) (count by (host_name, persona, service_version, session_id) (last_over_time(grok_code_token_usage_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))), "host_name", "(none)", "host_name", ""), "persona", "(none)", "persona", "")

panels.description: Grok Build version each VM and persona ran in the period, with its number of sessions. Two rows for one persona means it changed version in the period.

panels.title: Cost by Persona

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (persona) (increase(grok_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)), "persona", "(none)", "persona", "")

panels.description: Cost per hour, stacked by persona. Legend total = cost in the whole-hour buckets shown.

panels.title: Cost by Model

targets.expr: sum by (model) (increase(grok_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: Cost per hour, stacked by model.

panels.title: Token Usage by Type

targets.expr: sum (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type="input", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) - (sum (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type="cache_read", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) or vector(0))
sum (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type="cache_read", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

sum (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type="output", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) - (sum (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type="reasoning", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) or vector(0))
sum (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type="reasoning", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: Tokens per hour, stacked by type. Grok Build counts cache reads inside input and reasoning inside output, so uncached input + cache read + output (excl. reasoning) + reasoning = input + output.

panels.title: Token Usage by Persona

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (persona) (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type=~"input|output", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)), "persona", "(none)", "persona", "")

panels.description: Input + output tokens per hour, stacked by persona.

panels.title: Context size per API call

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(max_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | stop_reason!="" | unwrap input_tokens [$__auto] offset -$__auto) by (host_name, persona), "host_name", "(none)", "host_name", ""), "persona", "(none)", "persona", "")

panels.description: Largest prompt sent to the model in each bucket: input_tokens of one API call, cache reads included. It grows with the conversation, and so does the cost of every call, until the session restarts. API calls are the events that carry a stop_reason.

panels.title: Turns by Outcome (per hour)

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (increase(grok_code_turn_count_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: Turns that ended per hour, stacked by outcome.

panels.title: Active Sessions by VM (per hour)

targets.expr: label_replace(count by (host_name) (sum by (host_name, session_id) (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) > 0), "host_name", "(none)", "host_name", "")

panels.description: Sessions that used tokens in each hour, stacked by VM. A session spanning several hours counts in each. Legend max = busiest hour.

panels.title: Tool Calls by Tool (per hour)

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (increase(grok_code_tool_usage_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: Tool executions per hour, stacked by tool.

panels.title: When each persona was active

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(sum by (host_name, persona) (increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) > 0, "host_name", "(none)", "host_name", ""), "persona", "(none)", "persona", "")

panels.description: Green where the persona used tokens in that 5-minute bucket (or wider on long ranges).

panels.title: Turn latency: TTFT / TTFM

targets.expr: sum (increase(grok_code_turn_ttft_milliseconds_sum{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) / sum (increase(grok_code_turn_ttft_milliseconds_count{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(grok_code_turn_ttft_milliseconds_bucket{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)))

sum (increase(grok_code_turn_ttfm_milliseconds_sum{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) / sum (increase(grok_code_turn_ttfm_milliseconds_count{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(grok_code_turn_ttfm_milliseconds_bucket{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)))

panels.description: Per turn: TTFT = time to first token. TTFM is Grok Build's turn.ttfm timer, which Grok Build doesn't document. Solid = mean, dashed = p95. p95 is interpolated inside the histogram's buckets (… 1000, 2500, 5000, 10000 … ms), so with few samples per bucket it can be off by up to a bucket width; the mean is exact.

panels.title: API latency p50 / p95

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | stop_reason!="" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto] offset -$__auto) by (model)

quantile_over_time(0.50, {service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | stop_reason!="" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto] offset -$__auto) by (model)

panels.description: Duration of each model API call. API calls are the events that carry a stop_reason. Solid p95, dashed p50.

panels.title: Turn duration p50 / p95

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | tool_call_count!="" | duration_ms!="" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto] offset -$__auto) by (model)

quantile_over_time(0.50, {service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | tool_call_count!="" | duration_ms!="" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto] offset -$__auto) by (model)

panels.description: End-to-end time of each turn, including its tool calls. Turn ends are the events that carry tool_call_count and duration_ms. Solid p95, dashed p50.

panels.title: API calls by model

targets.expr: sum by (model) (count_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | stop_reason!="" [$__auto] offset -$__auto))

panels.description: Model API calls per time bucket. API calls are the events that carry a stop_reason.

panels.title: Prompts by persona

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(sum by (host_name, persona) (count_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | prompt_length!="" [$__auto] offset -$__auto)), "host_name", "(none)", "host_name", ""), "persona", "(none)", "persona", "")

panels.description: User prompts per time bucket. Prompts are the events that carry a prompt_length.

panels.title: Errors by category (per hour)

targets.expr: sum by (error_category) (increase(grok_code_error_count_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: Errors counted by Grok Build per hour, by error_category (grok_code.error.count). Failed tool calls are counted separately, in the Overview and the log panel below.

panels.title: Tool success rate

targets.expr: (sum by (tool_name) (increase(grok_code_tool_usage_total{outcome="success", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)) or sum by (tool_name) (increase(grok_code_tool_usage_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)) * 0) / sum by (tool_name) (increase(grok_code_tool_usage_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored))

panels.description: Share of tool executions that succeeded.

panels.title: Tool duration p95 by tool

targets.expr: sort_desc(quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | tool_name!="" | duration_ms!="" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]) by (tool_name))

panels.description: 95th percentile run time per tool. Tool results are the events that carry tool_name and duration_ms.

panels.title: Failed tool calls, cancelled turns and errors

targets.expr: {service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | outcome=~"error|cancelled" or error_category!="" | line_format `{{ .host_name | default "(none)" }}  {{ .persona | default "(none)" }}  {{.model}}{{ with .tool_name }}  {{.}}{{ end }}  {{.outcome}}{{ with .error_category }}  {{.}}{{ end }}{{ if .duration_ms }}  {{.duration_ms}}ms{{ end }}`

defaults.noValue: No failed tool calls, cancelled turns or errors

panels.description: Tool results and turn ends whose outcome is error or cancelled, and events that carry an error_category. Newest first. Click a line for all its fields (session_id, tool_name, outcome, ...).

panels.title: Startup time

targets.expr: sum (increase(grok_code_startup_total_milliseconds_sum{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) / sum (increase(grok_code_startup_total_milliseconds_count{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(grok_code_startup_total_milliseconds_bucket{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)))

defaults.noValue: No startup data for this VM / persona

panels.description: Time from launch until Grok Build is ready. Solid = mean, dashed = p95. p95 is interpolated inside the histogram's buckets (… 1000, 2500, 5000, 10000 … ms), so with few samples per bucket it can be off by up to a bucket width; the mean is exact. Only launches that report it count (so far, headless grok -p runs). Startup metrics carry no user or model, and launches sent without the nexus headers carry no VM or persona, so those show only under All.

panels.title: Startup phases (average)

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (phase) (increase(grok_code_startup_phase_duration_milliseconds_sum{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona"}[$__range] anchored)) / sum by (phase) (increase(grok_code_startup_phase_duration_milliseconds_count{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona"}[$__range] anchored)))

defaults.noValue: No startup data for this VM / persona
